title.narrative: Supply of Medical Equipment for UNHCR Tunisia

description.narrative: UNOPS supports UNHCR's efforts to enhance healthcare capacity for refugees and asylum seekers in the Medenine Governorate of Tunisia by providing the requested medical equipment, as specified by local health authorities. This effort will improve the quality and accessibility of healthcare services, supporting local hospitals in better serving vulnerable populations and aligning with UNHCR's commitment to refugee inclusion in national health systems.\n\n
